title: "EDA of Sporting Event Venues"
output: html_document
date: "2026-07-24"
---

```{r}
# read joined data (joins done in source/data)
wc_data <- read.csv("../../data/processed/worldcup_stadiums_joined.csv")
oly_data <- read.csv("../../data/processed/olympic_venues_joined.csv")

dim(wc_data)   # 265 WC venues
dim(oly_data)  # 983 Olympic venues
```

```{r}
# clean + group the Olympic status text into 3 states (match on the leading words)
s <- tolower(trimws(oly_data$current_status))
oly_data$status_group <- ifelse(startsWith(s, "dismantled"), "dismantled",
                         ifelse(startsWith(s, "not in use"), "not in use",
                         ifelse(startsWith(s, "in use"), "in use", NA)))
table(oly_data$status_group, useNA = "ifany")

# same for the New / Existing / Temporary / Mixed classification
b <- tolower(trimws(oly_data$venue_classification))
oly_data$build_group <- ifelse(startsWith(b, "existing"), "Existing",
                        ifelse(startsWith(b, "temporary"), "Temporary",
                        ifelse(startsWith(b, "mixed"), "Mixed",
                        ifelse(startsWith(b, "new"), "New", NA))))
table(oly_data$build_group, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
# map host countries to regions
region_map <- c(
  "France" = "Western Europe", "Germany" = "Western Europe", "West Germany" = "Western Europe",
  "Netherlands" = "Western Europe", "Belgium" = "Western Europe", "Switzerland" = "Western Europe",
  "Austria" = "Western Europe", "England" = "Western Europe", "United Kingdom" = "Western Europe",
  "Italy" = "Southern Europe", "Spain" = "Southern Europe", "Greece" = "Southern Europe",
  "Yugoslavia" = "Southern Europe",
  "Sweden" = "Northern Europe", "Norway" = "Northern Europe", "Finland" = "Northern Europe",
  "Russia" = "Eastern Europe", "Soviet Union" = "Eastern Europe",
  "United States" = "North America", "Canada" = "North America", "Mexico" = "North America",
  "Brazil" = "South America", "Argentina" = "South America", "Uruguay" = "South America",
  "Chile" = "South America",
  "Japan" = "East Asia", "China" = "East Asia", "South Korea" = "East Asia",
  "Australia" = "Oceania", "South Africa" = "Africa", "Qatar" = "Middle East")

wc_data$region <- region_map[wc_data$country_name]
oly_data$region <- region_map[oly_data$host_country]

# check every country got a region (no TRUE)
table(is.na(wc_data$region))
table(is.na(oly_data$region))
```

```{r}
# era buckets by event year
wc_data$era <- factor(ifelse(wc_data$tournament_year <= 1945, "pre-WWII",
                      ifelse(wc_data$tournament_year <= 2000, "postwar", "recent")),
                      levels = c("pre-WWII", "postwar", "recent"))
oly_data$era <- factor(ifelse(oly_data$games_year <= 1945, "pre-WWII",
                       ifelse(oly_data$games_year <= 2000, "postwar", "recent")),
                       levels = c("pre-WWII", "postwar", "recent"))
```

## Descriptive statistics for continuous variables

```{r}
# continuous summary stats, plus spread (sd)
wc_num <- c("stadium_capacity", "gdp_per_capita", "city_pop_thousands", "opened_year", "tournament_year")
summary(wc_data[, wc_num])
round(sapply(wc_data[, wc_num], sd, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# Olympic side: fewer numeric vars (no capacity)
oly_num <- c("gdp_per_capita", "city_pop_thousands", "games_year")
summary(oly_data[, oly_num])
round(sapply(oly_data[, oly_num], sd, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Descriptive statistics for categorical variables

```{r}
# WC categorical: counts + proportions
table(wc_data$newly_built);    round(table(wc_data$newly_built) / sum(table(wc_data$newly_built)), 3)
table(wc_data$design_purpose); round(table(wc_data$design_purpose) / sum(table(wc_data$design_purpose)), 3)
table(wc_data$current_status); round(table(wc_data$current_status) / sum(table(wc_data$current_status)), 3)
table(wc_data$region)
table(wc_data$era)
```

```{r}
# Olympic categorical
table(oly_data$build_group);  round(table(oly_data$build_group) / sum(table(oly_data$build_group)), 3)
table(oly_data$status_group); round(table(oly_data$status_group) / sum(table(oly_data$status_group)), 3)
table(oly_data$region)
table(oly_data$era)
```

```{r}
# closure reason recorded on WC side only
table(wc_data$not_in_use_reason)
```

## Region by era

```{r}
# region x era spread (matters for edition split)
table(wc_data$region, wc_data$era)
table(oly_data$region, oly_data$era)
```

## Missingness

```{r}
# missing values in country joins (not imputing yet)
colSums(is.na(wc_data[, c("gdp_per_capita", "cpi_score", "city_pop_thousands", "stadium_capacity", "opened_year")]))
colSums(is.na(oly_data[, c("gdp_per_capita", "cpi_score", "city_pop_thousands")]))
```

## Figures

```{r}
# WC venues by region
barplot(table(wc_data$region), las = 2, cex.names = 0.7,
        main = "World Cup venues by region", ylab = "venues")
```

```{r}
# venues by era, both events
era_both <- rbind(WorldCup = table(wc_data$era), Olympic = table(oly_data$era))
barplot(era_both, beside = TRUE, legend = TRUE,
        main = "Venues by era", ylab = "venues")
```

```{r}
# WC capacity distribution
hist(wc_data$stadium_capacity, breaks = 30,
     main = "World Cup stadium capacity", xlab = "capacity (seats)")
```

```{r}
# GDP per capita, both events (log scale)
boxplot(wc_data$gdp_per_capita, oly_data$gdp_per_capita,
        names = c("World Cup", "Olympic"), log = "y",
        main = "Host GDP per capita at award year", ylab = "GDP per capita (log scale)")
```

```{r}
# newly-built vs current use (WC): share not in use, by build status
use_tab <- table(wc_data$newly_built, wc_data$current_status)
share_notinuse <- use_tab[, "not in use"] / rowSums(use_tab)
barplot(share_notinuse, ylim = c(0, 0.2),
        main = "World Cup: share not in use, by build status",
        xlab = "newly built", ylab = "share not in use")
```

## The 123 not-in-use Olympic venues

```{r}
# the six ways "not in use" is written in the IOC data
oly_ni <- oly_data[oly_data$status_group == "not in use", ]
table(oly_ni$current_status)

# two of those six say demolished, so split the 123 on those
dem_values <- c("Not in use (demolished)", "Not in use\n(demolished)")
demolished <- oly_ni$current_status %in% dem_values
table(demolished)

# the ones still standing: which Games are they from, and what were they?
standing <- oly_ni[!demolished, ]
standing$games <- paste(standing$host_city, standing$games_year)
sort(table(standing$games), decreasing = TRUE)[1:5]
table(standing$build_group[standing$games_year == 2004])
```

## Duplicate records

```{r}
# no fully duplicated rows on either side (row count = distinct row count)
nrow(wc_data) - nrow(unique(wc_data))
nrow(oly_data) - nrow(unique(oly_data))

# WC: stadium + tournament year is a unique key; 265 rows are 238 distinct stadiums
nrow(wc_data) - nrow(unique(wc_data[, c("stadium_id", "tournament_year")]))
length(unique(wc_data$stadium_id))

# Olympic: venue name + games year is NOT unique. Three keys appear twice.
oly_key <- paste(oly_data$venue_name, oly_data$games_year)
key_counts <- table(oly_key)
key_counts[key_counts > 1]

# the one that matters: two Minor Arena rows that disagree about the outcome
oly_data[oly_data$venue_name == "Minor Arena",
         c("venue_name", "games_year", "host_city", "current_status")]
```

## Collinearity

```{r}
# correlation matrix of the WC numeric predictors (no pair above 0.7)
round(cor(wc_data[, wc_num], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"), 2)
```
